The PR's only change in this file is a documentation edit to docs/developer/test.md, with changed head lines 142-153. It rewrites the CI build-cache description and adds a paragraph on the MiMo audio gate. The shown units (head lines 928-1845) are unchanged context: Add-On Hold, App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification, cluster and tooling test docs. The changed hunk is outside the supplied unit ranges, so I read it from the patch excerpt.

Cache policy: the old text let a pull request save its build cache when it restored nothing. The new text says only pushes to dev or master save a cache, and PRs restore and save nothing. This narrows cache-write privilege and reduces the PR-to-base cache-poisoning surface. No threat-model asset (A-001 through A-019) or boundary (TB-002 through TB-013) is touched, and no provider code, key handling, attestation, ciphertext or cache-at-rest behavior (T-041) changes.

Audio gate: the MiMo audio gate is described as conditional on path inputs, running on master pushes and otherwise skipped. It is a test-selection statement only and does not change a runtime security control. One residual question for integration: whether CI scripts (scripts/ci-component-paths.py, the workflow's cache save conditions) actually match this documentation. Those are outside the supplied evidence, so I record that as an unverified contract, not a finding. Skipping the audio gate on unrelated PRs is a CI coverage choice, not a provider regression.

No security regressions or threat-model invalidations were identified.
